decision.reason: The only evidence is one changelog line [ev-12b17c85ab22]. It says Kafka Connect configuration moved to the ConfigMap the operator creates. It does not say where the configuration was before, such as an env var, a pod annotation or a different file. It also names no key, path or resource identity. Because of that, no subject family can be pinned down, and protocol-behavior (wire/protocol semantics) is not supported. Answering this needs the linked PR or documentation showing the previous mechanism and the exact relocated item, so the subject can be typed (for example env-var removed or config-key added) instead of guessed.
